```python
broader_search = await web_search("University of Leicester dragon diet fish bag volume cubic metres Hiccup", max_results=10)

```
I’m checking for indexed copies or summaries using the paper title without punctuation and the likely calculation terms.
```python
title_search = await web_search("Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish Maintain Dragon Diet Leicester paper", max_results=10)
print(title_search)
``` 

The search index is sparse, so I’m trying the University of Leicester paper repository and exact phrase variants.
```python
repository_search = await web_search("site:le.ac.uk \"Hiccup\" \"fish\" dragon", max_results=10)
print(repository_search)
``` 

I’m using a shorter keyword query to locate the paper’s PDF or a quoted passage containing the bag calculation.
```python
keyword_search = await web_search("fish bag dragon diet University Leicester volume", max_results=10)
print(keyword_search)
``` 

The session scope failed because no thread ID was available; I’m checking the permanent knowledge scope for the paper.
```python
agent_paper_search = await knowledge_search_knowledge("Can Hiccup Supply Enough Fish to Maintain a Dragon’s Diet fish bag volume", scope="agent")
print(agent_paper_search)
``` 

I’m checking the University of Leicester’s publication pages directly for the title.
```python
leicester_page = await web_fetch("https://www.google.com/search?q=%22Can+Hiccup+Supply+Enough+Fish+to+Maintain+a+Dragon%27s+Diet%22", max_chars=12000)
print(leicester_page)
``` 

I’m querying the scholarly metadata service by exact title to locate the paper or its full-text link.
```python
crossref_lookup = await web_fetch("https://api.crossref.org/works?query.title=Can%20Hiccup%20Supply%20Enough%20Fish%20to%20Maintain%20a%20Dragon%27s%20Diet&rows=5", max_chars=12000)
print(crossref_lookup)
``` 

I’m searching for the unit and notation used in the calculation, including “m3” and “m^3”.

print(unit_search)
``` 

I’m checking an alternate public search endpoint because the primary search returned no indexed result.
```python
bing_lookup = await web_fetch("https://www.bing.com/search?q=%22Can+Hiccup+Supply+Enough+Fish%22", max_chars=12000)
print(bing_lookup)
``` 

I’m making one final targeted repository search for the paper’s likely PDF location.
```python
final_repo_search = await web_search("site:le.ac.uk/pst \"fish bag\" dragon", max_results=10)
print(final_repo_search)
